articles.title: McDonald's CEO expects high inflation, lackluster traffic are here to stay
articles.summary: McDonald's is predicting that flat traffic and higher inflation will continue to weigh on the restaurant industry, CEO Chris Kempczinski said Wednesday. "One of the things I've talked to our team about is we need to stop talking about that being a difficult environment, and just say that is the environment," Kempczinski said on CNBC's "Squawk on the Street."
